currency.basis: 2017 rebrand announced by CGD press office and documented by dated independent sources; no later redesign observed as of 2026-10-04. Live cgd.pt verification blocked by 403 (technical, disclosed).

identity.basis: The vector is the CGD 'Caixa' symbol (hexagonal interlocking mark with green/red Portuguese-flag brush accents); file attributed to Caixa Geral de Depósitos and matches the design depicted (defectively) by the accepted SVG.

assessment.independenceRationale: Commons vector credited to CGD (one attribution chain), CGD press-office rebrand announcement (official), and direct offscreen/raster comparison of the accepted SVG; not copies of one source.

variant.basis: Standalone symbol without wordmark in official colors; same variant as the accepted baseline but with complete brush strokes and original geometry.

candidate.detailsJudgement: All original details preserved: hexagonal interlocking symbol geometry, blue fill, and both green and red gradient brush strokes including their texture edges; internal transparency unchanged.
candidate.proportionsJudgement: Emblem proportions match the source exactly (uniform scale only); it fits the 54 dp cell with margins on both themes and remains recognizable at small sizes.
candidate.rationale: Repairs the accepted icon's lost green brush stroke and restores the original geometry of the current CGD 'Caixa' mark from the original 2017-rebrand vector credited to CGD.
candidate.role: standalone bank symbol without wordmark on transparent background
transforms: Original SVG used as source; CSS class fills inlined as presentation attributes (no geometry change); source viewBox already crops the 212.6 canvas to the emblem
Set width/height proportional to the source viewBox (54 x 43.23); uniform scale only, no crop or distortion of the emblem

mr.title: Bank icon: Caixa Geral De Depositos (Company.id 15878)

proposals.reason: Accepted SVG drops most of the green brush stroke of the current CGD 'Caixa' mark (offscreen render shows only a tiny green sliver beside the red stroke, while the original vector renders full green+red strokes), a visible render/geometry repair supported by the original vector. Proposal replaces it with the original SVG of the 2017-rebrand mark (blue #0071B9 symbol with green/red brush accents), credited to Caixa Geral de Depósitos.

sourceCandidate.rationale: Original vector of the current CGD 'Caixa' mark with complete green/red brush strokes; repairs the accepted SVG's missing green stroke and restores original geometry. Catalog presentation (white symbol on blue square field) to be adapted in the working SVG from the original paths.
